The `lint` step failed on `modernize`/`embedlit` in `server/forge/gitlab/gitlab.go`: the new diffs options named the embedded `ListOptions` type. `PerPage` is now set on the promoted field, the same way as the other list calls in that file.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.

we woodpecker maintainers dont have issues with ai aided contributions, as longvas the contributor understands AND take ownership of the code AND did direct ai e.g. had final say of how to ... just proxy stuff back and forth between ai without looking e.g. meetproxy we dont like!

so writing comments like last one are not good!!!

PS: if you need ai to support grama or translation is fine
tldr: dont waist our time and take ownershipbof code and communication especially
